Could also be "危险驾驶" but they emphasize vehicle damage and public safety. In Chinese criminal law, article 133 (故意毁坏财物罪) includes destroying vehicles causing danger. Here it's intentional. So likely "故意毁坏财物" (intentional property damage). In examples, they used "故意毁坏财物" for case of high-speed car smashing.
